period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 30 June 2026. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. The Balance Sheet's own two printed Total-Assets figures disagreed by exactly 3,000,000,000 (top-of-page 'Total Assets' read as 481,116,334,253 vs bottom-line 'Total Liabilities & Shareholders' Equity' read as 484,116,334,253 -- the same leading '1' misread as '4' pattern seen elsewhere in this corpus). Resolved in favour of 481,116,334,253: Total Liabilities (454,729,352,506, itself ties out exactly from its own components) + Total Equity (26,386,981,747) = 481,116,334,253 exactly, and 'Other assets' (blank/garbled in the raw OCR as '42,296,832,432', implausibly large) is algebraically implied as 12,296,832,431 once the other 7 asset lines and the 481,116,334,253 total are taken as given -- internally consistent and roughly in line with this line's recent history (~9-13bn). 'Statutory reserve' read as exactly 11,065,754,350 (identical to Paid-up capital, which is suspicious and breaks the reserve's expected monotonic growth from 11,144,395,497 in quarterly/2026_Q1.json), but Total shareholders' Equity is independently confirmed via the balance-sheet identity above, so this dataset's total_equity and reserve_fund fields do not depend on resolving that sub-line. Retained surplus for the half-year: printed as 31,134,548 but the appropriation chain (Net profit 239,248,911 minus Appropriations 208,117,363, both independently exact) forces 31,131,548; this dataset uses the arithmetic-derived figure, which also ties the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L cross-check exactly (Dec-25 481,014,532 + 31,131,548 = 512,146,080, matching the printed Jun-26 Surplus-in-P&L to BDT 0) where the raw OCR figure would leave a BDT 3,000 residual.
